text:
Maya: Quick check — launching tri-mode pages next Tues. Need final hero copy for Hosted/Dedicated/Private + 3 launch posts. Short sync? :wave:

Sam: I'm free 10:30am. Can we pick one hero that scales across pages?

Priya: Prefer tailored heroes. Hosted = "Start fast, scale later". Dedicated = "Predictable throughput, enterprise SLA". Private = "Bring inference behind your firewall". Quick picks.

Olivia: Love those. Need subheads for benchmark mention: "~50% lower tail latency vs unmanaged endpoints" — can legal sign off? @Ben

Ben: Legal: avoid absolute claims. Suggest "consistently lower tail latency in internal benchmarks". Ok to keep numbers in blog but not hero.

Maya: Good call. For launch posts, we plan three short posts + one benchmark deep-dive webinar. Webinar angle: Ops+ML engineers — demo live load with Dedicated bursting to Hosted fallback. Thoughts on CTAs?

Priya: CTA matrix: Hosted -> start-free, Dedicated -> request-demo, Private -> contact-sales. Also add "benchmark report" link in all three.

Sam: For inbound routing: Hosted leads go to self-serve funnel + HubSpot form, Dedicated/Private route to AE queue. Proposed rule:

Sam: ```
if (page == 'hosted') route = 'marketing-funnel'
elif (page in ['dedicated','private']) route = 'ae-queue'
```

Priya: Add 'benchmark_interest' tag for any downloads so AE gets context.

Olivia: Creative: can we make a single modular hero with toggles? Could simplify A/B testing.

Maya: Timeline: copy freeze EOD Fri, content for 3 posts by Mon, webinar dry run Wed. @Priya you own copy, @Sam you own lead routing, @Olivia creative.

Ben: I'll review compliance language by Thur morning.

Priya: On it. I'll post PR with final copy tonight. :rocket:

Sam: Will update routing rules and add HubSpot webhook.

Olivia: I'll mock up modular hero variants and send screenshots. :art:

Maya: Thanks team — small checklist in thread pinned. Let's ship. :tada:
